dominant_strengths: Typography hierarchy works well with clear title/body distinction and readable serif choice
Content itself demonstrates writing principles through its own clarity and structure
Native macOS window chrome with proper traffic lights creates familiar context
dominant_weaknesses: Excessive negative space wastes 60% of viewport, forcing unnecessary scrolling
Generic dark theme with no visual identity beyond standard editor conventions
Orange accent for 'verbose' feels arbitrary without systematic color logic
fix_priorities: Tighten vertical spacing to show more content without compromising readability
Add subtle visual elements (rules, margins, pull quotes) to break monotony
Develop coherent accent color system tied to content meaning
Consider split-pane or marginalia for richer writing environment
rationale.norman_balance: Strong reflective design through meaningful content overshadows weak visceral appeal from generic dark editor aesthetic.
rationale.intent_fit: Succeeds as a writing interface through clarity and focus, but misses opportunities for richer authoring tools.
